title: Sai Urja Indo Ventures IPO Details
intro:
Sai Urja Indo IPO is a book build issue of ₹24.95 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 18.29 lakh shares aggregating to ₹20.67 crores and offer for sale of 3.79 lakh shares aggregating to ₹4.28 crores.

Sai Urja Indo IPO opens for subscription on Sep 23, 2026 and closes on Sep 25, 2026. The allotment for the Sai Urja Indo IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 28, 2026. Sai Urja Indo IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 30, 2026.

Sai Urja Indo IPO is set issue price band at ₹107 to ₹113 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,71,200 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹4,06,800.

Shannon Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Sai Urja Indo IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Sai Urja Indo IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Sai Urja Indo IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Sai Urja Indo IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Sai Urja Indo IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Sai Urja Indo IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: Sai Urja Indo IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,71,200 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Sai Urja Indo IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Sai Urja Indo IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Sai Urja Indo IPO will be done on Monday, September 28, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 29, 2026 . Check the Sai Urja Indo IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Sai Urja Indo IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 30, 2026 .
